title: Computing finite pro-etale compact-support composition on a compatible tower
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum $A=A_{E,n}$ and separated finite-type $k$-schemes of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. Use the ordinary pro-etale adjunctions $Lu^*\dashv Ru_*$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], open extension by zero of [def-weil-extension-by-zero], the candidates $Rf_!^c=Rp_*j_!$ of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], and their composition maps $\alpha_{g,f}$ of [thm-sf-comp-composition], on bounded-below etale-origin complexes [def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory]. Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to S$ be separated finite-type $k$-morphisms. Supply compactifications [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]
$$Y\xrightarrow{i}\overline Y\xrightarrow{q}S,\qquad X\xrightarrow{a}\overline X\xrightarrow{p}\overline Y,\qquad pa=if.$$
Thus $i,a$ are open and $q,p$ proper. Put $V=\overline X\times_{\overline Y}Y$, with projections $b:V\hookrightarrow\overline X$, $r:V\to Y$, and let $c:X\hookrightarrow V$ be the induced open map, so $bc=a$ and $rc=f$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Write $\delta:Lp^*i_!\xrightarrow{\sim}b_!Lr^*$ for the canonical open comparison of [lem-trf-open-square-exchange]. Define its proper-adjunction mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] by
$$\Gamma_Q=(Rp_*b_!\varepsilon_r)\circ(Rp_*\delta_{Rr_*})\circ\eta_{p,i_!Rr_*}:i_!Rr_*\longrightarrow Rp_*b_!,$$
where $\eta_p,\varepsilon_r$ are the units and counits of the ordinary adjunctions. On the three candidates for $f,g,gf$ given by $(c,r),(i,q),(a,qp)$, respectively, the specified composition map is
$$Rq_*i_!Rr_*c_!\xrightarrow{Rq_*\Gamma_Q c_!}Rq_*Rp_*b_!c_!\xrightarrow{\sim}R(qp)_*a_!.$$
The last arrow uses the ordinary derived-direct-image compositor [lem-weil-derived-direct-image-composition], in the normalization conjugate to the canonical pullback compositor [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition, def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate], and the open-extension compositor. The latter is the unique adjunction isomorphism whose conjugate is the canonical composite-restriction comparison, using the pro-etale open adjunctions [prop-weil-open-closed-recollement-adjunctions]. For arbitrary chosen compactifications, conjugating this displayed map by the specified comparisons of [prop-compactification-coherence-detailed] gives $\alpha_{g,f}$ as an equality of natural transformations. In particular the formula uses the proper identifications $Rr_!=Rr_*$ from $(\mathrm{id},r)$, rather than an arbitrary proper-coincidence isomorphism.

proof.text: First check the hypotheses of the site-comparison tools. A field is Noetherian since its only ideals are $0,k$. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian], $X,Y,S$ are Noetherian. Proper morphisms are of finite type by [def-weil-proper-morphism], so the same lemma applied successively to $q,p$ gives this for $\overline Y,\overline X$. Since $b$ is an open immersion, [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-open-subscheme-noetherian] gives it for $V$. These schemes are quasi-separated by [lem-weil-pbc-locally-noetherian-quasi-separated], hence qcqs; [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](1) makes every arrow here qcqs. The base change $r$ of $p$ is proper by [lem-weil-pbc-proper-base-change], and $qp$ is proper by [lem-weil-pbc-proper-composition]. Thus all three displayed pairs really are compactifications; the supplied factorizations $bc=a$, $rc=f$ fix their open and proper factors.

source.place: Tag 0F7J (lemma-shriek-composition), compatible-tower diagram; checking its qcqs specialization

proof.text: Fix a witnessed input $K\simeq\nu_X^*L$, $L\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory]. The comparison [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison] and exactness on the two sites [lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact, lem-weil-extension-by-zero-exact, lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact] give, termwise, $c_!K\simeq\nu_V^*(c_!^eL)$, a bounded-below etale-origin witness for $N=c_!K$. The three candidate functors of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed] are, literally, $Rr_*c_!$, $Rq_*i_!$, $R(qp)_*a_!$. In particular their composite source is $Rq_*i_!Rr_*c_!$. We will compute maps on these functors, retaining the supplied witness whenever site transport is used.

source.place: Tag 0F7J, first and fourth equalities; proetale.tex Tag 09AF (lemma-jshriek-comparison), finite-level passage to complexes

proof.text: For the last open-extension arrow put $J=b_!$, $K_b=b^*$, $I=i_!$, $K_i=i^*$. The ordinary derived open adjunctions and their invertible units are [prop-weil-open-closed-recollement-adjunctions]. For any $M$ on $X$ and $H$ on $\overline X$, their Hom bijections give $\operatorname{Hom}(b_!c_!M,H)=\operatorname{Hom}(M,c^*b^*H)=\operatorname{Hom}(M,a^*H)$. The middle comparison restricts to the same open $X$ since $bc=a$. The unit-preserving uniqueness in [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation] therefore gives $\kappa:b_!c_!\xrightarrow{\sim}a_!$ whose conjugate is exactly that restriction comparison. This fixes the final open compositor without choosing an automorphism of $a_!$.

source.place: Tag 0F7J, second equality: open composition, specified by its adjunction

proof.text: Write $P=Lp^*$, $R=Rp_*$, $Q=Lr^*$, $T=Rr_*$. The other final arrow is $d_{q,p}^{-1}:Rq_*Rp_*\to R(qp)_*$ from [lem-weil-derived-direct-image-composition](1). Its ordinary adjunction normalization can be checked before any compactification calculation: inverse images for constant $A$ are exact and the derived adjunctions are induced by the sheaf adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. The canonical pullback compositor is the termwise sheaf compositor [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. The constant-module sheaf categories are Grothendieck abelian by [lem-cbc-sieve-module-sheaves-grothendieck], applied to these small sites. At the sheaf level, the Hom bijection for composite inverse image is the composite of the two adjunction bijections, so the corresponding direct-image comparison sends a section on the iterated fibre product to itself. Apply [lem-sfb-derived-composition-adjunction-normalization] to these exact inverse images: the derived direct-image compositor is the conjugate of the inverse-oriented pullback compositor, as in [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate]. Its K-injective representative is the canonical sheaf direct-image composition, so it is the same ordinary compositor $d_{q,p}$, with the direction just specified. Thus the final map will be $d_{q,p}^{-1}\circ Rq_*Rp_*(\kappa)$.

source.place: Tag 0F7J, second equality; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0D6E (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition); derived.tex Tag 09T5 (lemma-derived-adjoint-functors)

proof.text:
Specify the interchange used in the etale-origin construction. Let $C_H=\nu_H^*$, let $e_j:Cj_!^e\xrightarrow{\sim}j_!C$ be the canonical open comparison and $b_u:CRu_*^e\xrightarrow{\sim}Ru_*C$ its counit-normalized direct-image comparison. Apply the site clause of [lem-sp-proper-open-coefficient-mate] with $k=b$, bottom open $i$, and proper verticals $r,p$, and with its finite ring $R$ equal to our $A$. It identifies the transported etale proper/open map with $C_Q:i_!T\to RJ$ whose open transpose is $\lambda^{-1}$, where
$$E:K_iR\longrightarrow TK_b,\qquad \lambda=T(u_b^{-1})\circ E_J:K_iRJ\longrightarrow T.$$
Here $u_b:1\to K_bJ$ is the open unit. The exchange transported in that clause is the actual ordinary unit--counit exchange $E$, by [lem-weil-pbc-transport-identifies-exchange]. The transported open unit is $u_b$: the unit equation of [lem-sf-open-comparison-unit-normalization] descends termwise by [lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact, lem-weil-extension-by-zero-exact]. Thus
$$C_Q=\varepsilon_i\circ I(\lambda^{-1})$$
on witnessed bounded-below inputs, as an equality of named maps. In particular $\lambda$ and $C_Q$ are invertible there.

source.place: more-etale.tex Tag 0F7B (lemma-shriek-proper-and-open); proetale.tex Tags 099R (section-comparison) and 09AF (lemma-jshriek-comparison): canonical site transport and open-unit normalization.

proof.text:
We now identify this open-normalized map with the proper mate in the question. Let $u_i:1\to K_iI$ be the other open unit and let $s:K_bP\xrightarrow{\sim}QK_i$ be the canonical pullback square comparison. The normalization of $\delta:PI\to JQ$ from [lem-trf-open-square-exchange] means
$$K_b(\delta_M)=u_{b,QM}\circ Q(u_{i,M}^{-1})\circ s_{IM}.$$
Consequently $K_b(\delta^{-1}_M)u_{b,QM}=s_{IM}^{-1}Q(u_{i,M})$. Using the explicit mate formula [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], the mate of $\delta^{-1}:JQ\to PI$ under the two open adjunctions is
$$K_bP(\varepsilon_{i,H})\circ K_b(\delta^{-1}_{K_iH})\circ u_{b,QK_iH}.$$
Substitute the preceding identity at $K_iH$, and use naturality of $s^{-1}$. This becomes $s_H^{-1}\circ QK_i(\varepsilon_{i,H})\circ Q(u_{i,K_iH})=s_H^{-1}$ by the open triangle identity [prop-weil-open-closed-recollement-adjunctions]. This calculation fixes which inverse of the pullback square occurs.

source.place: Tag 03S6 (lemma-shriek-base-change), open normalization; the pro-etale normalization is the main-20261015 lem-trf-open-square-exchange.proof.md. Explicit mate computation for the proper/open map of more-etale.tex Tag 0F7B.

proof.text: Take a further mate of $s^{-1}:QK_i\to K_bP$ under $P\dashv R$, $Q\dashv T$. It is exactly $E:K_iR\to TK_b$ by [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], since $s^{-1}$ is the canonical square pullback identification. The iterated-mate equality [lem-trf-iterated-square-mates] says that $E$ is the conjugate of $\delta^{-1}$ for the composite adjunctions $PI\dashv K_iR$ and $JQ\dashv TK_b$. By [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate], the conjugate of $\delta$ is therefore $E^{-1}$. This uses invertibility of a conjugate between composite adjoints, not invertibility of an arbitrary square mate.

Take the mates in the opposite order. Under $Q\dashv T$, $P\dashv R$, the proper mate of $\delta$ is, by [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate],
$$G=(RJ\varepsilon_r)\circ(R\delta_T)\circ\eta_{p,IT}:IT\longrightarrow RJ,$$
which is exactly the specified $\Gamma_Q$. Under the two open adjunctions its further mate is the conjugate of $\delta$, hence $E^{-1}:TK_b\to K_iR$, by [lem-trf-iterated-square-mates] and Step 7. Apply [lem-pur-mate-unit-compatibility] to this second mate. For every $N$ on $V$ it gives
$$K_i(G_N)\circ u_{i,TN}=E^{-1}_{JN}\circ T(u_{b,N}).$$
The left side is the $I\dashv K_i$ transpose of $G_N$. The right side is $\lambda_N^{-1}$ by the definition in Step 5. Therefore $G$ and $C_Q$ have the same open transpose.

source.place: Tag 0B65 (lemma-transformation-between-functors-and-adjoints); Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Adjunction/Mates.lean, unit_mateEquiv (lines 136–138) and iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv (lines 438–467), for the unit equation and the two iterated mate orders.

proof.text: Injectivity of the open-adjunction Hom bijection [prop-weil-open-closed-recollement-adjunctions] now gives $\Gamma_Q=C_Q$ on the witnessed bounded-below category. Every formula used in Steps 5--8 is natural in $N$, so this is equality of natural transformations. In particular the transported canonical etale proper/open arrow, whose normalization Step 5 fixes, is precisely the proper mate of $\delta$ appearing in the statement.

source.place: Tag 0F7B, canonical proper/open arrow: comparison of its two adjunct descriptions

proof.text: Compute the named compact-support composition on the supplied tower by expanding its construction, rather than invoking an unspecified isomorphism. The four-line computation in Tag 0F7J runs, in the forward direction, from $Rq_*i_!Rr_*c_!$ first by $Rq_*C_Qc_!$ to $Rq_*Rp_*b_!c_!$, then by the open compositor $\kappa$ of Step 3 and the ordinary direct-image compositor of Step 4 to $R(qp)_*a_!$. The etale arrow used here is the one of [lem-cbc-proper-open-interchange-coherence]: on a K-injective representative $H$ and a resolution $b_!^eH\to I_H$ it is $i_!^er_*^eH\cong p_*^eb_!^eH\to p_*^eI_H$. This is the identical representative specifying [lem-amb-unbounded-proper-open-interchange], so its transport is exactly the $C_Q$ of Step 5. This spells out the defining construction of the named $\alpha$ of [thm-sf-comp-composition]; that theorem supplies its preservation of the witnessed class and choice independence, not a new tower-formula assertion. Substituting $C_Q=\Gamma_Q$ from Step 9 gives the displayed two-arrow map, with every factor specified.

source.place: Tag 0F7J (lemma-shriek-composition), first four-line computation, together with Tag 0F7B, K-injective representative of its interchange; thm-sf-comp-composition.proof.md, Construction

proof.text:
For arbitrary chosen compactifications let $t_f:F_f\xrightarrow{\sim}Rr_*c_!$, $t_g:F_g\xrightarrow{\sim}Rq_*i_!$, $t_{gf}:F_{gf}\xrightarrow{\sim}R(qp)_*a_!$ be the specified comparisons [prop-compactification-coherence-detailed]. If $M_Q$ is the map computed in Step 10, the construction and independence clause of [thm-sf-comp-composition] gives
$$\alpha_{g,f}=t_{gf}^{-1}\circ M_Q\circ(t_g\star t_f).$$
Here $\star$ is horizontal composition of natural transformations. The cocycle clause of the coherence proposition cancels comparisons through a common refinement, so this equation uses those comparisons for every choice. Finally, when viewing the proper factor $r$ as compact support, its model is $(\mathrm{id}_V,r)$: the candidate definition [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed] gives $Rr_*\mathrm{id}_!\simeq Rr_*$. The isomorphism $\mathrm{id}_!\simeq\mathrm{id}$ is the unique adjunction comparison of Step 3 for an identity open. Hence the occurrence of $Rr_*$ above is the specified proper identification, with no free choice of a proper-coincidence automorphism.
